tool_schemas.name: image_generation
tool_schemas.description: Creates a text-to-image generation request from an English `image_prompt` and optional `width`/`height` (default 1024×1024), queues it for processing, and returns the generated image asset URL(s) when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `image_prompt` is missing/empty or if `width`/`height` are not integers or otherwise invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the API client is not authenticated/allowed to create generation requests, and raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the client has exceeded its generation limits.

tool_schemas.name: list_generation_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists generation requests belonging to the authenticated API client, newest first, with optional filtering by status and time range. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid.

idempotency_key.description: Filter by an exact idempotency key.

created_after.description: Return requests created at or after this UTC timestamp.

created_before.description: Return requests created before this UTC timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: get_generation_request
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single generation request by id (including its status and any terminal error fields) for the authenticated API client. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist or is not owned by the caller, and UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid.

include_assets.description: If true, also returns any image assets for the request.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_generation_request
tool_schemas.description: Cancels a queued or running generation request owned by the authenticated API client by transitioning it to status='cancelled'. Refuses with CONFLICT if the request is already terminal, NOT_FOUND if not owned/found, and UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid.

tool_schemas.name: list_image_assets
tool_schemas.description: Lists image assets for the authenticated API client, optionally filtered by generation request and/or asset status. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid.

request_id.description: Filter assets belonging to a specific generation request id.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: get_image_asset
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single image asset by id for the authenticated API client, including its public_url when available. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist or is not owned by the caller, and UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid.

metadata.name: text2image
metadata.description: This backend stores text-to-image generation requests, the resulting generated images, and the API clients that create them.
